# Pre-Tasks Requirements Review Checklist: Taskify Kanban Board

**Purpose**: Check the quality of the requirements for security and input validation, real-time
updates and notifications, and UX/accessibility, plus consistency between the spec, plan, contracts,
designs and constitution, before running `/speckit-tasks`.
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/) · [design/](../design/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Security & Input Validation

- [ ] CHK001 Is the "selected user required" rule stated for every kind of access, including the notification panel and the live-update channel, not only projects, tasks and comments? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the "MUST NOT be exposed to untrusted networks" constraint written as a verifiable requirement (e.g., where Taskify may listen) rather than only as guidance? [Measurability, Spec §Security Considerations]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define how character limits are counted (characters vs. bytes; emoji and accented letters) for the 100, 200, 1,000, 2,000 and 5,000 limits? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "trim leading and trailing whitespace" defined for multi-line fields and for non-standard whitespace (tabs, non-breaking spaces, blank lines)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are validation limits specified for every input the user can send, including the target column and position of a move and the notification actions? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-013, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "a clear message" for rejected input defined consistently (where it appears, what it names) across the task, project and comment forms? [Clarity, Consistency, Spec §FR-020, US2-4, US3-4, US4-2]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "system identifiers beyond what the user already sees" defined clearly enough to decide which ids may appear in error messages? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK008 Is plain-text display (FR-021) required in every place user text appears, including notifications, breadcrumbs, page titles and the user-chip area? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the rejection semantics for another user's resources consistent: comments say "reject" (planned as 403) while notifications are planned as 404 — is the difference intended and stated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §FR-031; contracts/rest-api.md]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the spec state whether access denials and validation failures must be audited, as Constitution Principle V lists them as security-relevant events? [Consistency, Gap, Spec §FR-023; Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it stated in the spec (not only in the plan) that creating notifications and marking them read are not audited? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023; research.md R7]
- [ ] CHK012 Is a retention period or size limit defined for the audit log? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the behavior defined when a stored user selection no longer matches a valid user (e.g., after sample data is recreated)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005]

## Real-Time Updates & Notifications

- [ ] CHK014 Is "users viewing the affected board or task" defined precisely enough to know whether the project list (task counts, new projects) must also update live? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the live-update and notification latency targets consistent across SC-003 (2 s), FR-029 (2 s), SC-009 and the plan's Performance Goals? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003, §FR-029, §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the conditions for measuring the 2-second targets stated (local machine, number of open windows, board size)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the reconnect requirements cover notifications and the unread count, or only the "open view"? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-015, §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK018 Is user feedback while live updates are disconnected (e.g., an indicator) specified or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the behavior defined when a live update changes a task whose title or description the user is editing at that moment? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-011, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the outcome specified for a user who is mid-drag when another user moves the same card? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK021 Does "assigns a task to them" in FR-026 clearly include creating a task with an assignee already set? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-026; data-model.md Creation rules]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the notification wording defined for each event type, including whether a comment preview is shown (the design shows one; the spec does not mention it)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028, US5-3; design notifications-panel]
- [ ] CHK023 Does the spec say whether a notification shows the task title at the time of the event or the current title after a rename? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-027; research.md R7]
- [ ] CHK024 Is "their next visit" defined (next page load, next time the user is selected)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029, US5-5]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the unread-count display defined for large numbers (e.g., "99+"), which only the plan specifies? [Gap, Spec §FR-028; contracts/ui-screens.md]
- [ ] CHK026 Is it specified whether unread notifications removed by the 100 limit still count toward the unread total? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK027 Is read-state syncing across several open windows of the same user specified? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK028 Is it specified that the notification panel and count switch immediately when the user switches identity, so the previous user's notifications are never shown? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, §FR-031]

## UX & Accessibility

- [ ] CHK029 Are loading states required by the spec for the board, project list, task details and notification panel, or do they exist only in the designs? [Gap, Spec §User Stories; design board-loading]
- [ ] CHK030 Is "visually distinct" for the current user's tasks defined with specific properties, consistent with the "not color alone" rule? [Measurability, Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK031 Can SC-008 "at a glance" be measured objectively (time limit or success rate)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK032 Are keyboard requirements stated for every interactive surface added after FR-025, such as the notification panel, the delete confirmation and the assignee selector? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the comment delete confirmation a requirement, or only a design assumption? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019; design-prompt.md Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is a minimum supported desktop window width specified (the designs use 1024px)? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 Do the WCAG AA contrast requirements conflict with the glass design, where the exported column glass is lighter than planned? [Conflict, Spec §FR-025; design/tokens.md]
- [ ] CHK036 Are not-found, error and empty states worded and timed consistently between the spec edge cases and the UI contracts (toast text, auto-dismiss)? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases; contracts/ui-screens.md]
- [ ] CHK037 Is reduced-motion behavior (drag tilt, skeleton shimmer) specified as part of the accessibility requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]

## Cross-Document Consistency

- [ ] CHK038 Does the plan's Complexity Tracking still list the monolith as a deviation, now that Constitution v2.1.0 Principle III requires a modular monolith? [Conflict, plan.md §Complexity Tracking; Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK039 Are the plan's Technical Context versions consistent with the constitution's Technology Stack (Node.js 24, TypeScript ~5.9, Angular 21.x, Python 3.12)? [Consistency, plan.md §Technical Context; Constitution §Technology Stack]
- [ ] CHK040 Are the Stitch elements marked "do not implement" (search, tabs, tags, due dates) excluded in the spec's out-of-scope assumptions as well as in design/tokens.md, so the two lists match? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions; design/tokens.md]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Scope chosen: security and input validation, real-time and notifications, UX and accessibility,
  plus cross-document consistency; standard depth; for review before `/speckit-tasks`
- Items marked `[Gap]`, `[Ambiguity]` or `[Conflict]` are the likeliest to need a spec or plan
  change; resolve them with `/speckit-clarify` or by re-running `/speckit-plan`
